panels.description: For each block extracted from the output Peano queue, the time it waited for lower-numbered blocks ("holes") that delayed its extraction. The total line is a true per-block quantile (selected by $percentile) of each block's total interleaving wait, recorded once for every extracted block (including a zero for in-order blocks that never waited), so it covers the same per-block population as the output-stage duration panel and is directly comparable to it, showing how much of that latency is due to ISS segment interleaving. The per-leader series are the same quantile of the individual per-block contributions attributed to the assigned segment leader responsible for each delaying hole; because quantiles are not additive they do not sum to the total line, but they show the typical delay contributed by each leader/segment. See the companion average panel for an additive per-leader/total breakdown.

panels.description: For each block extracted from the output Peano queue, the time it waited for lower-numbered blocks ("holes") that delayed its extraction. The total line is a true per-block quantile (selected by $percentile) of each block's total interleaving wait, recorded once for every extracted block (including a zero for in-order blocks that never waited), so it covers the same per-block population as the output-stage duration panel and is directly comparable to it, showing how much of that latency is due to ISS segment interleaving. The per-leader series are the same quantile of the individual per-block contributions attributed to the assigned segment leader responsible for each delaying hole; because quantiles are not additive they do not sum to the total line, but they show the typical delay contributed by each leader/segment. See the companion average panel for an additive per-leader/total breakdown.

panels.title: Delivery delay due lower-numbered blocks per leader - percentile (not additive)

panels.description: Mean per-block interleaving wait: total accrued wait-seconds divided by the number of blocks emitted (the output-stage-duration block rate). Unlike the quantile panel, means are additive, so the per-leader series sum exactly to the total line and break the average interleaving wait down by the assigned segment leader responsible for each delaying hole. The total line is derived from the same per-leader output-block-interleaving-wait series (summed over all leaders), so it works on historical data without the output-block-interleaving-total-wait stage that only the quantile panel requires. Compare the total line with the output-stage-duration average panel to see the mean share of output-stage latency due to ISS segment interleaving.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_sum(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-block-interleaving-wait"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by (namespace, job, node) (histogram_count(rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_performance_ordering_stage_latency_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",node=~"$node",ordering_stage=~"output-stage-duration"}[$__rate_interval])))
